strategies.name: Detect Unsecured Credentials Shared in Chat Messages

analytics.name: Analytic 0309
analytics.guidance: Detection correlates message events in email and collaboration tools (e.g., Outlook, Teams) that contain regex-like patterns resembling credentials, API keys, or tokens. Anomalous forwarding or bulk copy activity of chat/email content containing secrets is flagged. Suspicious behavior includes users pasting secrets into direct messages or attaching config files with passwords.

tuning.description: Customizable credential-detection regex (e.g., API_KEY=, bearer token formats) depending on enterprise apps in use
Exclude known trusted domains or automated system-to-system messages
Adjust correlation period for bulk credential sharing events

log_sources.name: m365:unified
log_sources.channel: MessageSend, MessageRead, or FileAttached events containing credential-like patterns

analytics.name: Analytic 0310
analytics.guidance: Detection monitors SaaS collaboration tools (e.g., Slack, Zoom, Jira) for messages or files containing credential-like patterns, or for suspicious API calls retrieving bulk chat histories by non-admin users. Identifies adversary behavior chains where chat logs are queried via APIs or integration bots to systematically extract sensitive material.

tuning.description: Tune to ignore known enterprise bots with message-read access (e.g., DLP scanners)
Customizable regex for detecting secret formats (JWT, OAuth tokens, SSH keys)
Correlate with user role to filter developers vs standard users

log_sources.name: saas:slack
log_sources.channel: chat.postMessage, files.upload, or discovery API calls involving token/credential regex

log_sources.name: saas:okta
log_sources.channel: Unusual OAuth app requesting message-read scopes for Slack/Teams/Jira
